policy.continuous: One actual tap/s, at most one visible drop collected/s; paid decisions every 10 seconds.
policy.shortSessions: Online [0,600) and [3600,3900); otherwise no taps, drops or manual decisions. Actual offline domain integration in 10-second slices, return decisions occur exactly at session start; no simulated manual actions before return.
policy.hardware: At most one regular manual purchase/10s, highest marginal Credit/s per Credit among affordable classes. Post-prestige autobuyers only after buying their node and toggling the real domain action.
policy.research: Data generation to Lv2, model architecture to Lv1, then paid Blueprints key project.
policy.crafting: First relay, then quantum-chip with paid learning and real module crafting, then known extended recipes.
policy.analysis: Only start when the actual paid quote is affordable. No implicit analysis queue; repeat short hardware analyses while the chip or first extended blueprint is outstanding.
policy.prestige: First reset at >=3 INT on a manual decision with no active analysis; cancelled training and continuing jobs are reported. No later resets within this comparison.
policy.priority: Model-first attempts model/research before crafting/analysis. Materials-first reserves Data until the first analysis starts, then attempts craft/analysis before model/research. No resource or formula changes.
policy.initial: Actual newGame/runStartContract, including 50 starting Credits, zero hardware and 50 unspent starting Gems.
policy.precision: Manual events sampled every 10s; observed passive/claim milestones resolution up to 10s. Same seed does not imply matched draw streams after actions diverge.
policy.trace: Full traces are checked for session boundaries and cost accounting; persisted samples show the first 20 and last 10 state-changing manual actions. Aggregate counts and booked cost totals retain all actions.
policy.limits: Eight selected two-hour profiles. Two seeds are not drop probability estimates, player behavior data or week/month calibration.

earnedBuildComparison.scope: Instant same-hardware/equal-account equipment contrast; separate copies only, no changes to controller. Relay burst behavior remains in its actual special-effect quote.
